The decisive mistake was made by Financial_Expert at step 9. Its code treats the sheet as one flat table and assumes that dropping rows with a missing Name removes the section rows. But the "Zone 2" row has a Name, so it survives the filter. The agent never checked the later zones of the sheet, which is where the correct Finance vendor must be, so the calculation it set up could not produce the correct answer.

STEP: 9
